# sink_amber_pump_bottle — articulation audit and repair

Status: **FAIL / incomplete physical certification**. The repaired rig passes synthetic collision checks; the supplied video does not show actuation for this asset. No ARTCHECK_DONE marker is warranted.

- Replaced filled collar/neck contact with an open bore and separate pump stem/pad colliders.
- Fitted bottle yaw/XY, pump extension and nozzle length to visible controls in two calibrated views.
- Added MJCF/URDF and a tested spring return; 350 N/m and 0.7 N preload are declared engineering priors.

The ten-position sweeps include every original joint with explicit inter-body contacts, including parent/child pairs. Maximum baseline penetration: 0.9709 mm; repaired penetration: 0.0000 mm. The exported visual triangles were also swept at ten positions per joint; see the report for their separate results. Coupled endpoint states: 2. GLB/OBJ maximum vertex discrepancy: 0.00000093 mm.

Calibrated source frames: f0008, f0082, f0168. Strict maximum assembly edge error across these views: 20.10 px; worst frame p95: 10.63 px. These exceed the requested 10 px maximum. All measurements are at 1280 x 1707 before review resizing. Source masks, per-part traced edges, geometry projections and actual CPU Cycles renders are retained. Silhouette fitting, material/specular boundaries, glass, occlusion and calibration/scale uncertainty remain limitations; this is not a 1 cm metric certification.

No maximum actuation or physical stop can be recovered from these unactuated frames. The open cap is a static state, not an observed motion sequence. No q from the 26-front articulation file or 25-part splat state file maps to these joints. Force, mass, friction and hidden hardware details remain priors.
